Life-Changing Private Burnout Recovery Retreat Find Yourself Again

We understand how exhausting life can become when stress, burnout and overwhelm take over. Perhaps you’ve been carrying too much responsibility, running on empty or pushing through each day while quietly losing touch with yourself. At Alive Luxury Private Burnout Retreats, you are met exactly where you are, so you finally feel seen, understood and fully supported.

Our private luxury burnout and stress recovery retreats in Bali and Mexico are designed for those seeking a completely personalised, confidential and high end experience. This is not a group retreat. You are supported one on one by your own dedicated team, allowing you to fully step away from pressure and focus entirely on yourself.

Since 2009, we have guided guests through our proven 360° holistic burnout recovery program, combining natural healing, mind body practices and personalised aftercare to create real, lasting change long after you return home.
Here, transformation happens on every level; mental, physical, emotional, energetic and lifestyle.

Your private team works exclusively with you, helping you release the weight of overwork, over giving and constant pressure, rebalance your nervous system and restore clarity, energy and inner calm, where you come first.
Every program includes the full Alive Process®, delivered entirely one on one, integrating a powerful range of therapies and modalities including:

Alive Process Executive Life Coaching & Holistic Counselling for clarity, direction and emotional reset Yoga Therapy, Mindfulness and Meditation to calm the mind and restore deep inner balance Movement and Nature Based Practices to release tension and rebuild vitality and presence Detox, Nutrition and Herbal Support with naturopaths and nutritionists to restore energy, sleep and physical balance

Health Analysis, Biohacking & Physical Restoration including IV, Ozone, Hot & Cold Plunge Cellular Regeneration Healing, Energy Work and Breathwork to clear emotional fatigue and reset the nervous system Hypnotherapy and Stress Release Techniques for mental clarity and renewal Aftercare and Life Integration Support to ensure lasting results beyond your retreat

Our guests include burnt out executives, high performing professionals, entrepreneurs, parents and individuals seeking a private, luxury burnout retreat experience where they can step away, reset and rebuild.

This is more than a stress retreat or burnout recovery program. It is a deeply personalised, confidential and life changing experience designed to restore your health, energy, clarity and connection to the life you want to live.

blocks.text: Expert Holistic Team Support

We start with a complete picture of your wellbeing understanding the whole person — physical, emotional, mental, relational, and lifestyle. Our detailed assessments help us tailor a program that meets your unique needs and ensures your retreat delivers the transformation you’re seeking.
Mind Tools To Regain Inner Calm

Discover inner calm and clarity through proven practices like mindfulness, meditation, breathwork, and deep relaxation. These tools help you recenter during life’s challenges and cultivate a long-lasting sense of peace and self-awareness.
Fitness & Movement

Movement becomes joyful again with activities designed to meet you where you are. From yoga therapy and functional fitness classes to guided hikes and adventures in nature, our fitness approach is about feeling strong, energised, and alive in your own body.
Heal With A Proven Method

Experience the Alive Powerful 8 Steps for Mental Health, a holistic approach to heal the physical, mental, emotional, and energetic drivers of burn out challenges. Our expert team offers transformative coaching sessions that equip you with essential tools for lasting change. Start journey to well-being and unlock your potential today
Healing Therapies

Your one on one healing sessions help you emotionally release what you are holding onto and reset hidden patterns that are driving the unconscious behaviours that cause burn out, exhaustion and overwhelm. Work with healers, kinesiologists, somatic breathwork practitioners that suit you personally to release the old and welcome the new.
Spa, Massage & Relaxation

With healing spa and massage sessions you experience hands on nurturing and stress release. Time to rest and reflect daily in the privacy of your own luxury beachfront pool villa or surrounding areas for deep reflection and peace.
Health & Energy REgeneration

From customised nutrition and detox plans, natural medicine, cleansing, biohacking including IV and ozone therapy, we focus on restoring balance across your whole body. The result is renewed energy, deeper sleep, and a vibrant sense of wellness that lasts long beyond your retreat.
Inspiring 1:1 Therapy

Through private sessions with our executive level life and wellness coaches or holistic counsellors, hypnotherapists, and holistic healers, you’ll experience powerful insights and breakthroughs. Our focus is forward-looking — helping you release old patterns and step fully into the greatest version of yourself.
New Purpose & Life Direction

Clarity creates momentum. With expert guidance, you’ll rediscover your passions, define your goals, and design an inspiring plan for your next chapter. Supported by our ongoing aftercare, you’ll leave not just with insight, but with motivation and a clear path forward.

blocks.text: Feeling like life is piling on and you can’t keep up?
Always working, doing, giving, always responsible — yet running on empty?
Worn down by constant stress, exhaustion, and overwhelm — and starting to notice the toll it’s taking on your health, sleep and ability to show up?
Struggling to find clarity, focus, or even the motivation to get through the day?
Watching your healthy habits slip away, but feeling too depleted to get back on track - where did all the hours in the day go?
Trying different solutions, but nothing seems to last — and the slope just feels steeper?
Losing touch with the person you used to be — and wondering if you’ll ever get back there?
Craving something intensive yet radically calming to stop the spiral and reset your life?
Longing for a new routine, a renewed sense of self-worth, and a deeper purpose aligned with the changes you know you’re ready to make?

If this sounds like you, you’re not alone — and recovery doesn’t have to take months or years. With the right guidance, it is possible to release the weight of burnout, restore your health and energy, and finally feel calm, clear, and in control again.

VIP Private Burnout Recovery for High Performers. 

It's time to stop hustling, heal and recreate from calm.

If you are a founder, executive, entrepreneur, creative or high performer experiencing chronic stress, exhaustion, burn out and loss of joy, this video is for you.

At Alive, we specialise in luxury retreats for burn out designed for leaders who carry a lot, give a lot and are ready for real recovery. This is not a spa holiday or a pop up wellness retreat. This is a private VIP burnout recovery retreat built to reset your nervous system, restore energy and help you realign your life.

⏱ TIMESTAMPS

0:00 – 0:20 | How burnout really feels for high performers
What chronic stress actually looks like behind success. Wired but exhausted. Loss of joy. Sleep issues. Why executives and founders silently struggle.

0:20 – 0:50 | What you have already tried and why it is not working
Therapy, apps, mindset, holidays, wine, supplements, uppers, downers, holidays. Why these are not real burn out recovery solutions and only treat symptoms.

0:50 – 1:10 | Why 360 burnout recovery works
Why a luxury retreat for burn out must work with the body, nervous system, mindset, relationships to self and others and life recreation at the same time for real long lasting results.

1:10 – 2:10 | Physical healing at our VIP burnout retreat
How we reset your nervous system, restore sleep, rebalance stress hormones, support gut health, inject nutrition, bio hack your health issues and rebuild energy naturally with no guesswork.

2:10 – 2:55 | Emotional healing and inner calm
Private one on one sessions, nervous system regulation, guided relaxation, breathwork, meditation, mindfulness, relaxation, visualisation and emotional release in a safe, supportive space.

2:55 – 3:35 | Mental clarity and confidence
How our holistic counsellors and Alive Process Executive coaches help you quiet the mind, regain focus and reconnect to your vision without reliving the past.

3:35 – 4:15 | Luxury retreat spaces and five star care
Your own private villa, pools, nature, space, stillness, ocean swims, mountain walks, waterfalls and real downtime between sessions.

4:15 – 4:50 | Our integrated expert team
How over 15 practitioners work together around you so you are never doing this alone.

4:50 – 5:20 | New purpose and life direction
What clients walk away with after their VIP burnout retreat. Confidence, clarity, boundaries and a new way of living.

5:20 – 5:45 | Book your confidential call
How to speak to a real coach and design your personalised retreat.
